snippet.title: Kart Maker is a Nintendo 64 Styled Game, where you make your own tracks just by driving
snippet.description:
There's an overhead editor too. The game feels like Crash Team Racing meets Sonic Racing games. It's scheduled to release as early access in 2026.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4020010/Mythic_Kart_Maker/

Support Development & Get Early Builds: https://www.patreon.com/c/DreamMix
